BiblicalUsage: Beth-Arbel means "house of God's Ambush." It was a place in Palestine, perhaps Gilead or Galilee. You will find it in Hosea 10:14.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Beth-Arbel matters because the land itself is part of the promise.
